segment_performance.segment: FMCG Others (Branded Packaged Foods, Personal Care)

simple_pointers: **Predictable Cash Generation:** Quarterly revenue grew to **₹19,850 Cr** (+7.35% YoY), highlighting resilient performance across cigarettes and packaged foods.
**High Operating Margins:** Consolidated operating profit touched **₹7,180 Cr** with an enviable **36.17%** operating margin.
**Steady Net Profit Growth:** Profit After Tax (PAT) climbed to **₹5,180 Cr** (+5.71% YoY), reaffirming reliable shareholder dividend support.
**FMCG Margin Expansion:** FMCG-Others EBITDA margin reached **11.4%**, demonstrating operational leverage in staple foods and personal care brands.
**Fortress Balance Sheet:** Net cash reserves exceed ₹18,000 Cr with zero debt; hotel business demerger successfully finalized.

strengths: Exceptional monopolistic cash generation in legal cigarettes with 75%+ national market share.
High ROCE (>38%) and dividend payout ratio (>80%) with negligible debt.
Extensive direct distribution network covering 7 million+ retail touchpoints across India.
weaknesses: Paperboards division experiencing margin drag from low-cost Chinese paper imports.
High dependence on tobacco for ~70% of total operating EBIT.
opportunities: Scale-up of premium personal care and luxury chocolates via quick-commerce channels.
Value unlocking post completed hotel business demerger.
threats: Potential adverse GST or excise tax changes in national budget cycles.
Illicit cigarette smuggling and duty-evaded local contraband products.
